<!-- What the change does, and the issue it closes if there is one. -->

## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Tests or corpus formulas cover the change.
- [ ] If the layout or the HTML changed: `npm run test:visual` passes.
- [ ] If a file was ported from Typst: it has its header, and `docs/UPSTREAM.md` lists it.
- [ ] If users will notice the change: `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for it under Unreleased.
